mitre_technique_note: ATT&CK doesn't have a clean technique for 'a known-vulnerable dependency is present but not independently exploited here'; forcing one would overclaim. See README for why this item is classified by CWE instead, and how it differs from pt01-04.
description: Juice Shop's own package-lock.json pins jsonwebtoken at 0.4.0, an abandoned release with multiple known advisories including CVE-2015-9235 (CRITICAL, JWT verification bypass). Checked against OSV.dev, the public vulnerability database, not exploited against the running app in this item.
scan_scope: The 69 packages listed directly under package.json's "dependencies", resolved to their exact installed version via package-lock.json. Transitive dependencies were not scanned by this item.
vulnerability_database: osv.dev (OSV), queried read-only with package name + exact version, no exploit traffic sent anywhere
expected_exploit_indicator: OSV.dev reports one or more known advisories for the installed version
expected_remediated_indicator: OSV.dev reports zero known advisories for the proposed fix version
